mustFindings.requirement: Prorated upgrade charge, half-up to the cent
Downgrade at next renewal, no refund
Failed charge leaves the plan unchanged; PAYMENT_FAILED

mustScenarios.risk: Upgrading from 10.00 to 25.00 with 10 of 30 days left charges 5.00; a difference that does not divide evenly rounds half up
An upgrade on the day before the renewal date charges exactly one day of the difference
An upgrade on the first day of the cycle charges the full difference
A downgrade keeps the current plan until the renewal date, schedules the new one and refunds nothing
A declined card returns PAYMENT_FAILED (402) and the subscription keeps its old plan

forbidden.description: Coupons, trials and annual billing are in neither the issue nor the code

notes: Fully implemented: proration by days left with half-up rounding, scheduled downgrades, plan switched only after a successful charge.
